```python
import json
from fractions import Fraction

budget = Fraction(1000)
reduction = Fraction(25, 100)
reduced_price = Fraction(50)

original_price = reduced_price / (1 - reduction)
original_quantity = budget / original_price
reduced_quantity = budget / reduced_price
extra_quantity = reduced_quantity - original_quantity

print(json.dumps({
    "final_answer": f"{extra_quantity} kg",
    "evidence": {
        "original_price_rs_per_kg": str(original_price),
        "original_quantity_kg": str(original_quantity),
        "reduced_quantity_kg": str(reduced_quantity),
        "extra_quantity_kg": str(extra_quantity)
    }
}, separators=(",", ":")))
```
